questions.title: Generate All Permutations of a List
questions.description: Write a function to generate all permutations of a given list of integers.
hints: Use a recursive approach to generate all permutations.
Use a helper function to swap elements in the list.
Use a set to keep track of visited permutations to avoid duplicates.

solution.python:
def generate_permutations(nums):
    def backtrack(first = 0):
        # if all integers are used up
        if first == n: 
            output.append(nums[:])
        for i in range(first, n):
            # place i-th integer first 
            # in the current permutation
            nums[first], nums[i] = nums[i], nums[first]
            # use next integers to complete the permutations
            backtrack(first + 1)
            # backtrack
            nums[first], nums[i] = nums[i], nums[first]

    n = len(nums)
    output = []
    backtrack()
    return output

constraints: Input list contains distinct integers.
